name: Kagaya Mitsuki
source:
A female student who is a daughter of a rich family. She is gentle, pure and graceful. Due to her strict upbringing, she has a modest personality and old-fashioned female values.
She has greatly honed her family raising skills, such as cooking and housework.

She suddenly marries the protagonist and makes every effort to love him. While she is a little embarrassed about the relentless amounts of sex, she truly loves the amount of pleasure she feels.
